summary: Steel lookout, 30 m, that Alberta's register dates to 2014; listed as active and reached by air. No site-specific history found.

access.note: Register lists the site as active with access mode fly (reached by air). It does not describe the site as closed. Alberta says the public may not climb lookout towers.

visit.trail_note: Register access mode is fly. No source found describes a public route to the site.

events.note: Register gives 2014 as the year the tower was constructed.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The register row is the only Cadotte-specific source. Two searches and the general Alberta pages (lonely lookouts history, how we fight wildfires) found no mention of this lookout, its 2014 construction, staffing or fate. The story therefore covers only the register facts and general Alberta context. Brief access closed is corrected to restricted, since the register lists the site as active with fly access. Alberta pages disagree on the network size (How we fight wildfires says 100 active lookout sites; Bears and fire lookouts says 127 sites), so no network count is used. Brief agency Alberta Wildfire is supported only by the agency's general lookout page, not by the register.
